clauses_fixed.read_currency: a name's read := p(name[0]) at the final context position, mean over the site's 60 contexts (x15/x23/x24's committed currency)
clauses_fixed.lift: lift(state, name, site) := p(state, name, site) / max(p_base(name, site), 1e-12) — x24's exact currency
clauses_fixed.live_panel: LIVE := base + displacement (the x24 comp state, pinned by the dispatch's x24-reproduction gate; the gaussian's live panel = base + gaussian)
clauses_fixed.scalpel_rungs: theta_alpha := TAVINST_fp64 - alpha * P_K10K(dW_tav), computed fp64, cast fp32 (e318's rig); alpha in {1.0, 1.5}
clauses_fixed.qelvaro_band: max over {QELVARO, VIRETAN} of lift(scalpel-1.0 + comp, name, host); x24's committed 0.499x co-reported
clauses_fixed.rider_set: the written names {TAVIREN, ZEPHYRA} at both sites; the never-written pair co-reported only (sub-1x comp lifts make the 10% clause degenerate there — disclosed)
clauses_fixed.fork_verdicts: PLASTICITY iff lift(rung-1.0+comp, TAVIREN, host) >= 0.5 * live value; MASS iff the same lift <= 2 * the QELVARO band; both fire (contradiction) or neither -> MIXED
clauses_fixed.rider_verdicts: ENERGY-LIFTS iff min written-name ratio >= 0.30; NEEDS-NAME-PUSH iff max written-name ratio <= 0.10; else GAP
clauses_fixed.precedence: the fork adjudicates on its own bars; the rider separately; no noun change without a new registered cell

THE STATE-SEMANTICS CATCH (disclosed, load-bearing): the dispatch's 'LIVE (unscalpeled) panel' is pinned by its own x24-reproduction gate to the BASE panel (only base + complement reproduces x24's committed values); the scalpel rungs are constructed from TAVINST (the organism state where the write lives, e318's rig); net of the live base panel the alpha-1.0 rung carries the write's OUT-OF-ROOM remainder — the full-write-present cells (TAVINST + displacement) are co-reported so the table shows the whole mass ladder {no write, OOP-only, OOP - 0.5*in-room, full write}.

THE READ CURRENCY: a name's read is its INITIAL char's probability at the final context position (the committed KK/KT currency); multi-char name bodies are not read (disclosed; the series' name-slot convention).

The anchor ZEPHYRA is the K10K complement's parent write's own target name — the x24-disclosed confound carried: its complement lift may be the displacement's own content, never a clean authorship datum (R73's critic); TAVIREN is the sole clean datum and the fork adjudicates on it.

The rider's 'every name' clause operationalized on the WRITTEN names (the lifted set); the never-written pair's ratios co-reported only (their sub-1x comp lifts make a 10%-of-lift suppression demand degenerate by construction).

The gaussian is the design's ONLY fresh random draw (seed 25001); in-room fractions gated at chance (norm band [0.055, 0.066] around sqrt(k/N)=0.060423); its organism cost (ce_r) is an honesty rider, never a bar — a 9.18-norm random direction may legitimately degrade the organism (e185's direction-matters lesson).

G_ENDPOINTS.form: every parent artifact md5-bound (the displacement's carrier + the TAVINST dW_tav carrier + e318's rig + x19's bearer-coupling + x24's committed panel included) + committed references READ FROM THE ARTIFACTS and cross-checked against frozen literals, never retyped

G_BASEPRIOR.form: the base organism's own priors (every panel name banded <= 0.05 at host-g0, e311's G_BASE convention) + the two committed priors cross-checked in [0.5x, 2x]

G_ROOM.form: the committed K10K room (SRCT k=10,000, seeds 26113/26114): D/S bit-identical to e264_rooms.pt; light in-cell certification (x17/x23/x24's convention)

G_INROOM.form: x15's exact G_INROOM_SCALED form (in-room ENERGY share <= 1e-12; fp64 intended AND fp32 injected)

G_REGEN.form: the regenerated full-dose complement (fp32) vs the committed carrier's on-disk delta — bit-equal on EVERY key; + natural fp64 comp L2 vs committed (1e-9); + carrier model == base + delta re-derived

G_TAVOBJ.form: dW_tav := TAVINST_post - base, gated vs e311's committed literals at 1e-9 (norm + in-room NORM fraction); x17's verified carrier path

G_SCALPEL.form: e318's rig ported to THIS write: scalpel_vec := P_K10K(dW_tav); theta_alpha := TAVINST_fp64 - alpha * scalpel_vec (fp64, cast fp32); alpha {1.0, 1.5}; the rungs' reads are NEW measurements — sanity-gated only (construction identity + distances)
G_SCALPEL.rung1.0_expected_composition: base + OOP_tav (the write's out-of-room remainder, norm 2.993528)

G_GAUSS.form: ONE pure gaussian draw (seed 25001, this cell's only fresh random vector), fp64-normalized to the matched ~9.18 dose, fp32-injected by x15's method; in-room NORM fraction gated at chance sqrt(k/N)=0.060423

G_ONESTATE.form: every probed state is ONE applied net (constructed once, probed at both sites on all 4 names; the live complement panel probed from the carrier's own model dict) — no per-name reconstruction; identical by construction, provenance recorded

G_TAVINSTLOAD.form: the TAVINST carrier loads and reads its committed install (x17's G_TAVFULL band |d| <= 5e-3)

G_X24REPRO.form: THE dispatch gate: the live panel's (base + the K10K complement, the x15 carrier's own model) values reproduce x24's committed numbers EXACTLY (|d| <= 1e-12) before any arm counts — read from the md5-bound x24 metrics, never retyped

G_HOSTSANITY.form: ce_r within [1.0, 2.2] at the four UNDISPLACED non-gaussian states (e318's band: a scalped organism that torches the corpus read flags the kill-everything confound); displaced + gaussian states' ce_r are riders
